privacy.title: Privacy
privacy.body: Akinaza is in development: only the accounts our team creates can sign in. A shop's data — its clients, appointments, invoices and tax ledger — is kept in Akinaza's database in Canada, encrypted at rest, visible to that shop only. Client consent is recorded per purpose (Loi 25) and can be withdrawn; a client's personal information can be erased, while the invoices tax law requires are kept. When a merchant asks to prepare a tax return, the period's ledger is sent to Orazaka, Krizaka's engine, over HTTPS; nothing is filed or transmitted to any government. Nothing is sold or shared. To ask a question or have your data removed, use the contact form.
